## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ManagedMessageBrokers`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `managed-message-brokers`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ManagedMessageBrokers**.

## Step 2: Create a managed Kafka server

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the WSO2 Cloud Console at [https://console.devant.dev/](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. <!-- manual: In the header, select your organization from the Organization list. -->
3. In the left navigation menu, select **Admin**.
4. Select **Message Brokers**.
5. Select **+ Create**.
6. <!-- manual: In Step 1: Provide server details, specify a display name for the Kafka server, then click Next. -->
7. <!-- manual: In Step 2: Select service plan, select your preferred cloud provider from DigitalOcean, GCP, AWS, or Azure. -->
8. The cloud provider provisions the compute and storage infrastructure for your Kafka server.
9. <!-- manual: There is no functional difference between Kafka servers created on different cloud providers, apart from changes to service plans (and associated costs). -->
10. <!-- manual: Select a region for your Kafka server from United States, Europe, or Australia. -->
11. <!-- manual: Available regions depend on the selected cloud provider. -->
12. <!-- manual: Select a service plan. -->
13. <!-- manual: Each plan lists the number of nodes, CPU, memory (RAM), and storage space allocated for your Kafka server, along with its backup schedule, backup retention period, and hourly price. -->
14. <!-- manual: Available plans depend on the selected cloud provider and region. -->
15. Select **Create**. This creates the Kafka server and takes you to the **Overview** tab on the server details page.
16. The status of the server remains **Creating** until provisioning completes. Some features and settings are disabled until the server becomes active.
